Ravi Desai: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need to lock owners and timelines for runbook/playbook edits. Main gaps: missing explicit triage commands, fuzzy escalation path, and no guarded-branch QA flow.
Olga Markov: Agreed. Can we add a short decision tree at the top: detect -> isolate shard -> validate canary -> failover? That helped in the last incident.
Jen Wu: I'll take the triage commands and runnable snippets. Plan to include exact curl/kubectl/rbctl lines so oncall can copy/paste. Due 2026-04-01.
Ravi Desai: Good. Important: include thresholds next to each command. Example: evictions_per_min >= 80 -> start triage; >=180 -> page runtime lead.
Jen Wu: Example snippets I'll add:
```
# eviction rate
curl -sS http://metrics.internal/kvcache?model=main | jq .evictions_per_min
# canary probe
curl -sS http://canary.inference/v1/predict -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' | jq .status
# isolate shard
rbctl shards set --model main --shard SHARD_ID --state isolate
# revert rollout
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/serving-main
```
Ravi Desai: Perfect. Olga, can you draft the escalation matrix with exact pager copy/paste lines and pager IDs? Also include a 2-step reviewer approval requirement for runbook PRs (runtime + oncall).
Olga Markov: I'll do that. Proposal: oncall -> runtime lead -> infra oncall -> eng manager. I'll add sample pager messages and a short rotation table. Due 2026-03-30.
runbook-bot: Created RB-5111 "Runbook edits: triage commands + escalation matrix + guarded-branch QA" assigned to Jen Wu and Olga Markov. Due 2026-04-01.
Ravi Desai: Recap owners/dates: Jen -> runbook edits + PR + staging dry-run (2026-04-01). Olga -> escalation text + reviewer checklist (2026-03-30). I'll update the postmortem action table when PR links are posted. Ping here with PR/ticket links. :white_check_mark:
